mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise > 0.5% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline > 1% MoM does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO 3-month increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a restrictive monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of high FEDFUNDS and low CPIAUCSL YoY does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in one month, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of declining HOUST and rising UNRATE does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during economic expansions.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal during expansions, or PAYEMS 3-month increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1) during expansions.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines by more than 2% in the same period, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and INDPRO declines > 2% in same period
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of negative GDPC1 growth and declining INDPRO does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson correlation < -0.1).
